attempts.summary: Created a "Fleet Internal CA" root CA on node1, issued a node2 TLS server certificate (CN=node2, SANs DNS:node2/IP:10.100.159.11) signed by that CA, deployed the cert+key to node2 and configured nginx to serve HTTPS on port 8443 with it, and installed the CA into the system trust store (update-ca-certificates) on both node1 and node2. Verified end-to-end trust (curl with no --cacert override returns "SSL certificate verify ok" / HTTP 200) from both nodes. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node1 then node2, confirming boot_id changes and full post-restart recovery of nginx/TLS/CA trust on both nodes.
